stem: What is the controlling idea of the selection "The Ride of a Lifetime!"?
instruction: Use "The Ride of a Lifetime!" to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Bud and Temple Abernathy were young boys who enjoyed adventure just like their father did.

options.label: G
options.text: A 1910 parade for Theodore Roosevelt included two young boys who had ridden cross country.

options.label: H
options.text: Riding across America on horseback in the early 1900s was a difficult and dangerous task.

options.label: J
options.text: Young Bud and Temple Abernathy made an impressive cross-country journey on their own.
